<span class="news-date">June 2026</span><span class="news-type">Talk</span>

### Presented longitudinal network research at the CISS Seminar

Presented *Who Gets Picked? A Longitudinal Network Analysis of Gender and Institutional Prestige in Education Research Funding* at CIAE, Universidad de Chile. [View the slides](files/slides/ciss-seminar-2026/index.html){target="_blank"}.
:::

::: {.news-item}
<span class="news-date">April-June 2026</span><span class="news-type">Research visit</span>

### Visiting Doctoral Researcher at Universidad Mayor

Joined the Society and Health Research Centre to collaborate with Diego Palacios on relational opportunity structures, extracurricular contexts, and peer-network dynamics in adolescence.
:::

::: {.news-item}
<span class="news-date">March 2026</span><span class="news-type">Publication</span>

### New comparative study of mathematics gender gaps

Published *Pathways to Gender Equity in Latin America and the Caribbean* with Lorena Ortega, Andrés Romero, Catalina Canals, and Alejandra Mizala in *Studies in Educational Evaluation*. [Read the article](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.stueduc.2026.101579).
:::

<span class="news-date">March 2026</span><span class="news-type">Teaching</span>

Delivered a session for the MA module *Independent Project* at the School of Communication & Creativity.
:::

### Joined a British Academy international-student collaboration

Contributed to *Making Europe a Global Magnet for International Students*, a Pump Priming collaboration led by Rachel Brooks at the University of Oxford.

<span class="news-date">December 2025</span><span class="news-type">Publication</span>

### Article on foreign students' transitions to higher education

Published *The Unfulfilled “Chilean Dream”?* with Cristóbal Zelada and Lorena Ortega in *Education Policy Analysis Archives*. [Read the article](https://doi.org/10.14507/epaa.33.8520).
:::
